title: Recipe book: exploring (starter 50)
note: Starter ideas from what the family buys. Each card is a version to explore: Family is the starting point. Not started until someone taps 'start'. Steps are short starters, shown once a recipe is started; look up versions for more.

recipes.name: Kimchi fried rice
recipes.description: Crispy rice with kimchi and an egg on top.
steps: Fry chopped kimchi in a little oil for 2 minutes.
Add cold cooked rice and a splash of soy sauce; stir-fry until hot and a little crisp.
Top with a fried egg.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
recipes.description: Rice bowl with vegetables, egg and chili paste.
steps: Cook rice. Blanch the spinach; cut carrots into thin sticks and soften them in a pan.
Fry an egg.
Put rice in a bowl, arrange the vegetables and the egg on top.
Add gochujang to taste and mix at the table.

recipes.name: Bulgogi beef bowls
recipes.description: Sweet, savoury marinated beef over rice.
steps: Slice the beef thinly and soak it in the bulgogi marinade for 15 minutes.
Cook it in a very hot pan for 2 to 3 minutes, in batches.
Serve over rice, with lettuce leaves to wrap.

recipes.name: Spicy Korean chicken stir-fry
recipes.description: Chicken, cabbage and gochujang in one pan.
steps: Mix gochujang with a little soy sauce and water.
Brown bite-size chicken in a hot pan.
Add cabbage and carrots, then the sauce; cook until the chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Oyakodon
recipes.description: Chicken and egg over rice in a sweet soy broth.
steps: Simmer soy sauce with a little water and sugar.
Add sliced chicken and cook until done.
Pour beaten egg over, cover, and cook until just set.
Slide onto a bowl of rice.

recipes.name: Teriyaki chicken
recipes.description: Glossy sweet-salty chicken with rice.
steps: Mix soy sauce with a little sugar and water.
Pan-fry the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Add the sauce and let it bubble until glossy. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Okonomiyaki
recipes.description: Savoury cabbage pancake with a sweet sauce.
steps: Mix flour, eggs and a little water into a thick batter.
Stir in finely shredded cabbage.
Fry as thick pancakes, about 4 minutes a side.
Top with mayonnaise and a sweet sauce.

recipes.name: Ramen with egg and spinach
recipes.description: Ramen with a soft egg and greens.
steps: Cook the ramen as the packet says.
Add spinach for the last minute.
Drop in an egg, or add a soft-boiled egg, and a splash of soy sauce.

recipes.name: Quick pho
recipes.description: Pho from a cup, with spinach and an egg.
steps: Make the pho cup with boiling water.
Add a handful of spinach.
Top with a soft-boiled egg.

recipes.name: Pad see ew
recipes.description: Wide noodles in soy and a little oyster sauce.
steps: Soak or cook the noodles.
Stir-fry broccoli in a hot pan, then push it aside and scramble an egg.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and a little oyster sauce; toss until coated.

recipes.name: Yellow curry chicken and potatoes
recipes.description: Mild-spicy curry with potatoes.
steps: Fry the yellow curry paste in a little oil for a minute.
Add chicken, potato chunks and carrots, and enough water or coconut milk to cover.
Simmer until the potatoes are soft and the chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Fried rice with stir-fry veg
recipes.description: Rice, eggs and the frozen veg mix.
steps: Scramble the eggs in a hot pan and set them aside.
Stir-fry the frozen veg until hot.
Add cold rice and soy sauce, then the eggs; toss until hot.

recipes.name: Chicken and broccoli
recipes.description: Quick stir-fry in oyster and soy sauce.
steps: Brown sliced chicken in a hot pan until cooked through.
Add broccoli and a splash of water; cover for 2 minutes.
Stir in oyster sauce and soy sauce. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Tomato and egg stir-fry
recipes.description: Soft eggs with sweet tomatoes.
steps: Scramble the eggs softly and set them aside.
Cook tomato wedges until they start to break down.
Add a little soy sauce, return the eggs, and fold together.

recipes.name: Black bean chicken
recipes.description: Chicken with black bean paste.
steps: Brown bite-size chicken.
Stir in chunjang and a splash of Shaoxing wine and water.
Simmer until the chicken is cooked and the sauce is thick.

recipes.name: Kung pao chicken
recipes.description: Peanut, chili and a little tang.
steps: Mix soy sauce, Shaoxing wine and a little sweet chili sauce.
Stir-fry diced chicken until cooked through.
Add the sauce and the peanuts; toss for a minute.

recipes.name: Garlic cabbage stir-fry
recipes.description: Quick cabbage with soy and oyster sauce.
steps: Fry sliced garlic in oil for 30 seconds.
Add shredded cabbage and stir-fry on high heat.
Season with oyster sauce and soy sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken lettuce wraps
recipes.description: Crisp lettuce cups with savoury chicken.
steps: Stir-fry finely chopped chicken until cooked through.
Season with soy sauce and oyster sauce.
Spoon into crisp lettuce cups.

recipes.name: Century egg congee
recipes.description: Silky rice porridge with century egg.
steps: Simmer 1 part rice in about 8 parts water, stirring now and then, for about an hour.
Chop the century egg.
Stir it in at the end, season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Orange chicken
recipes.description: Crisp chicken in a tangy orange glaze.
steps: Coat chicken pieces lightly in flour and pan-fry until cooked through.
Simmer orange juice, soy sauce and sweet chili sauce until syrupy.
Toss the chicken in the sauce.

recipes.name: Pancit
recipes.description: Noodles with chicken, cabbage and carrots.
steps: Soak or cook the noodles.
Stir-fry chicken until cooked, then add cabbage and carrots.
Add the noodles and soy sauce; toss until coated.

recipes.name: Chicken adobo
recipes.description: Vinegar, soy and garlic braised chicken.
steps: Put chicken, vinegar, soy sauce, garlic and a bay leaf in a pan.
Simmer covered for 30 minutes.
Uncover and reduce the sauce; serve with rice.

recipes.name: Aloo gobi
recipes.description: Potatoes and cauliflower, lightly spiced.
steps: Fry potato cubes in oil until golden.
Add cauliflower, carrots and your spices, with a splash of water.
Cover and cook until everything is tender.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
recipes.description: Creamy tomato sauce with chicken.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt for 30 minutes, then brown it.
Cook chopped tomatoes with butter and spices into a sauce.
Add the chicken and simmer until cooked through.

recipes.name: Pumpkin pasta with salami
recipes.description: Squash sauce, salami and pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Warm the pumpkin sauce with sliced salami.
Toss with the pasta and a little pasta water.

recipes.name: Pesto chicken pasta
recipes.description: Pesto, chicken and tomatoes over pasta.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Pan-fry chicken until cooked through, then slice.
Toss pasta with pesto, chicken and halved tomatoes.

recipes.name: Spinach and tomato frittata
recipes.description: Eggs baked with spinach, tomato and cheese.
steps: Soften spinach in butter in an ovenproof pan.
Pour in beaten eggs, add tomatoes and grated cheddar.
Cook on low until the edges set, then finish under the grill.

recipes.name: Baked eggs in tomato
recipes.description: Eggs baked in a tomato and pesto sauce.
steps: Warm chopped tomatoes with a spoon of pesto in a small pan.
Make wells and crack in the eggs.
Cover and cook until the whites are set.

recipes.name: Salami pizza
recipes.description: Cheddar, salami and tomato on bread.
steps: Spread crushed tomato on sliced bread or a flatbread.
Add salami and grated cheddar.
Bake at 220°C (425°F) until bubbling.

recipes.name: Anchovy garlic pasta
recipes.description: Anchovy, olive oil and a little chili.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Warm olive oil with garlic and the anchovies until they melt.
Toss the pasta in the oil with a little pasta water.

recipes.name: Cheddar mac and cheese
recipes.description: Baked pasta in a sharp cheddar sauce.
steps: Cook the pasta.
Melt butter, stir in a spoon of flour, then whisk in milk until thick.
Stir in grated cheddar, mix with the pasta, and bake until golden.

recipes.name: Potato and cheddar soup
recipes.description: Creamy potatoes with sharp cheddar.
steps: Simmer potato chunks in water until soft.
Mash or blend with butter and milk.
Stir in grated cheddar until melted.

recipes.name: Sheet-pan chicken and potatoes
recipes.description: Everything on one tray.
steps: Toss chicken, potato and carrot pieces with melted butter or oil.
Spread on a tray.
Roast at 220°C (425°F) for about 40 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.

recipes.name: Turkey chili
recipes.description: Lean turkey, tomatoes and cheddar on top.
steps: Brown the turkey.
Add chopped tomatoes, chili spices and beans if you have them.
Simmer 30 minutes. Top with cheddar.

recipes.name: Turkey burgers
recipes.description: Lean turkey burgers with cheddar.
steps: Season the turkey and shape into patties.
Cook in a pan until cooked through, about 5 minutes a side.
Add cheddar to melt; serve with lettuce, tomato and ketchup.

recipes.name: Turkey meatballs in squash sauce
recipes.description: Lean turkey meatballs in a squash sauce.
steps: Shape seasoned turkey into small balls and brown them.
Add the pumpkin sauce and simmer until the meatballs are cooked through.
Serve over pasta with cheddar.

recipes.name: Chicken quesadillas
recipes.description: Crisp tortillas with chicken and cheese.
steps: Fill tortillas with cooked chicken and grated cheddar.
Toast in a dry pan until crisp and the cheese melts.
Serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Chicken Caesar salad
recipes.description: Romaine, chicken, cheese and crisp bits.
steps: Cook and slice the chicken.
Toss chopped lettuce with dressing.
Top with chicken and grated cheese.

recipes.name: Spinach and apple salad
recipes.description: Spinach, apple and crunchy seeds.
steps: Slice the apple thinly.
Toss with spinach and a simple dressing.
Sprinkle the salad topper over.

recipes.name: Chopped salad with chicken
recipes.description: Salad kit, chicken and cheese.
steps: Open the salad kit into a bowl.
Add sliced cooked chicken, tomatoes and cheese.
Toss with the kit dressing.

recipes.name: Avocado toast with egg
recipes.description: Avocado on toast, topped with an egg.
steps: Toast the bread.
Mash avocado with salt and spread it on.
Top with a fried or poached egg.

recipes.name: Avocado and tomato salsa
recipes.description: Fresh salsa for chips.
steps: Dice avocado and tomatoes.
Season with salt and a squeeze of lime.
Serve with chips.

recipes.name: Plum crumble
recipes.description: Baked plums under a buttery top.
steps: Halve and stone the plums and put them in a dish.
Rub butter into flour (and sugar) until crumbly; scatter over.
Bake at 180°C (350°F) for 35 to 40 minutes.

recipes.name: Persimmon cookies
recipes.description: Soft spiced cookies with persimmon.
steps: Mash ripe persimmon.
Beat butter and sugar, add egg and the persimmon, then flour and spices.
Drop spoonfuls on a tray and bake at 175°C (350°F) for 12 to 14 minutes.

recipes.name: Mango yogurt bowl
recipes.description: Yogurt, dried mango and chia.
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Chop dried mango and scatter over.
Add a spoon of chia seeds.

recipes.name: S'mores bars
recipes.description: Graham, chocolate and marshmallow, baked.
steps: Press crushed graham crackers into a lined tin.
Spread Nutella, then top with marshmallows.
Bake briefly until the marshmallows puff and brown.

recipes.name: Nutella brownies
recipes.description: Fudgy brownies with a Nutella swirl.
steps: Mix Nutella, eggs, melted butter and flour.
Pour into a lined tin.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for about 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Peanut butter cookies
recipes.description: Chewy, with a fork pattern.
steps: Mix peanut butter, egg, butter and sugar.
Roll into balls and press with a fork.
Bake at 175°C (350°F) for 10 to 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Brown rice bowl with roast veg
recipes.description: Brown rice, roasted veg and chicken.
steps: Cook the brown rice.
Roast cauliflower and carrots at 220°C (425°F) for 25 minutes.
Add sliced cooked chicken and a dressing.

recipes.name: Corn and cheddar fritters
recipes.description: Corn, cheddar and egg fritters.
steps: Cut corn from the cob.
Mix with eggs, flour and grated cheddar into a thick batter.
Fry spoonfuls until golden on both sides.
